title: Abductees whose memories come back when they see the cover of Communion

tellings.quote: they'll see the cover of Communion, Whitley Streamer's book.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that some people who believe they were taken by non-human beings get their memories back when they see the cover of Communion, a book by the writer Whitley Strieber about his own such experiences. If true, it would suggest that real but buried memories can be triggered by a single image.
